eligibility_tiers.line: The student must present a cumulative grade point average (GPA) of 3.25 or higher in their Required High School Curriculum (RHSC) coursework (PDF), and the transcript must show evidence that the student is on track toward the completion of the USG RHSC requirements and high school graduation.
